newsitem.title: JAPAN: India issues tender to buy January crude.
newsitem.headline: India issues tender to buy January crude.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has tendered to buy one million barrels of crude oil for January delivery, traders said on Thursday.
The tender closes on November 28 and offers should be valid until November 29.
The tender covers a wide range of crude oil, including Gulf grades, Asian regional crudes and North Sea crudes.
IOC bought three very large crude carriers (VLCC) of Qua Iboe and four Dubai crude cargoes in its December tender.
